note: HS mismatch: declared HS 844590 (textile machinery) does not match the actual shipments, which are cotton yarn/thread under HS 5205 (52054710, 52054890, 52052890, 52054810); the company also imports textile machinery parts under 84483990. Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code corrected to the factual one (cotton yarn, HS 5205) — verdict accepted_hs_corrected, no rejection. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is also wrong: this is a cotton spinning/textile mill in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Export shipments are factual, not declared: dated customs/B-L records to Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Egypt and Italy, latest 2026-02-21, so the company is an active exporter. Related group entities appear in the same customs data (PREMIER COTTON TEXTILES, 185/244 ATD Street, Race Course — same address, 409 shipments, e.g. 2026-02-27 Cochin Sea -> Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, HS 52052410, B/L 1088606), which corroborates the group's real trading activity but is a separate legal entity and is not counted as Premier Mills' own shipments. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read. No sanctions/court issues were checked or used as grounds for anything.
